name: Lion
description: The king of beasts, a large carnivorous cat
facts: Lives in prides, males have distinctive manes, roar can be heard 9km away

name: Kangaroo
description: A marsupial known for powerful hind legs and hopping movement
facts: Can jump up to 10 meters, carries young in a pouch

name: Giant Panda
description: A rare black and white bear native to China
facts: Eats mostly bamboo, symbol of conservation, only about 1,800 in the wild

name: Jaguar
description: The largest cat in the Americas, a powerful predator
facts: Strongest bite force of any big cat, excellent swimmer, spotted coat

name: Polar Bear
description: A large white bear adapted to Arctic ice and snow
facts: Excellent swimmers, skin is actually black, fur appears white

name: Penguin
description: Flightless birds adapted to life in cold water
facts: Can dive to 500 meters, waddle on land, excellent swimmers

name: Elephant
description: The largest land animal with a long trunk and memory
facts: Trunk has 40,000 muscles, lives in herds, can live 70+ years

name: Koala
description: A tree-dwelling marsupial with fluffy ears, native to Australia
facts: Sleeps 20 hours a day, eats eucalyptus leaves, has fingerprints like humans

name: Giraffe
description: The tallest land animal with a long neck and spotted coat
facts: Reaches up to 6 meters tall, tongue is 50cm long, unique spot pattern

name: Bald Eagle
description: A large bird of prey and national symbol of the United States
facts: White head feathers, can see 8 times better than humans, lifespan 20-30 years
